problem_statement: When getopt_long()/getopt_long_only() encounter an unrecognized long option (e.g. --OptionX), the parser fails to skip over that argv[] entry: optind is not advanced and optptr is left pointing into the unrecognized option. As a result a command line ending in an invalid long option misbehaves (optind stays un-advanced / option count is wrong), producing an ERROR in the ostest getopt() tests. The fix must cause an unrecognized long option to be skipped (advance optind and clear optptr) so that parsing of the remaining options proceeds and the option count/optind checks pass.
